info.title: ACRWC LLC public services catalog
info.description: Read-only, signed-out catalog of ACRWC LLC consulting services. No authentication. To submit a quote inquiry, use the inquiry API described at https://acrwc-poppy.acrwc.workers.dev/openapi.json (POST /inquiries), only with the user's explicit approval. Requests may carry the Poppy-Session header; it is accepted and ignored because no Session claims are used (Poppy 1.0 sections 5.3 and 7).

get.summary: List consulting services and how to request a quote
